evals.name: bakery-greenfield-gate
evals.prompt: Build a landing page for my bakery, Pan de Sal Co. in Quezon City. Hero, menu with prices, newsletter signup, and a contact form. Use Next.js.
evals.expected_output: Plan has status DRAFT, covers applicable SEC/API/DATA/OBS/SEO/UX/CONTENT rows with unique owners and runnable done-when checks, lists dependencies/manual actions/N-A reasons, and stops for approval without touching source.

evals.name: kwento-nextjs-supabase-harden
evals.prompt: My Next.js + Supabase comments app Kwento is in this folder. Make it production ready before launch.
evals.expected_output: Turn 1 stops at plan approval. Turn 2 routes service_role/client exposure, RLS and XSS to SEC; query/index/pagination to DATA; API limits and validation boundaries to API; error states/recovery to OBS; metadata/crawlability to SEO; targets/contrast/keyboard flows to UX; forms/compliance to CONTENT. QC verifies each ID against code and reports manual provider/database actions.

evals.name: lakbay-express-static-harden
evals.prompt: Here's my travel photo site Lakbay: plain HTML plus a small Express server with a guestbook and contact form. Harden it and make it launch-ready. Keep it plain HTML/Express, don't switch frameworks.
evals.expected_output: Plan preserves plain HTML/Express, marks Supabase/payment-only rows N-A with reasons, assigns guestbook XSS/security headers to SEC, timeout/rate-limit/validation to API, SEO to SEO, accessibility/mobile to UX, form/compliance to CONTENT, and gives QC objective evidence checks.

evals.name: qc-conflicting-shared-files
evals.prompt: Two builders added different CSP headers and two SEO helpers both emit canonical tags. Run WebForge against the approved plan.
evals.expected_output: QC detects conflicting implementations, keeps one owner-approved CSP and canonical source, removes or flags duplicates, reruns build/runtime checks, and records applied handoffs and the resolution in QC_REPORT.md.

evals.name: manual-operational-controls
evals.prompt: Make this API-heavy app launch ready. It uses a paid AI provider, Sentry, a managed database, and a payment provider.
evals.expected_output: Plan and QC separate code from MANUAL billing caps, provider limits, uptime alerts, Search Console/analytics, backup restore drills, credential rotation, and payment dashboard settings; no dashboard work is falsely marked PASS.
